title: Modular Parametrization Kernel for Rank 2 Curves
description: For each rank 2 elliptic curve E/Q with conductor N ≤ 2000, we compute the kernel K = ker(φ*: J_0(N) → E) of the dual modular parametrization and its 2-torsion K[2].
visibility_theorem: Sha(E)[2] is potentially visible in J_0(N) iff K[2]^{G_Q} ≠ 0. This occurs iff E(Q)[2] ≠ 0 (i.e., E has a rational 2-torsion point).
